policy: Prefer off-the-shelf components and import their published CAD. Exact manufacturer/model identity must match the selected BOM; do not silently substitute or rescale a similar model. Custom PCB/mechanical component design is a fallback when needed.

reference_components.available_evidence: Manufacturer 2D mounting drawing and dimensional envelope; not supplier STEP
Author component identification; current sweep disks are clearance envelopes, not detailed propellers
Manufacturer manual; no matching 3D download found on checked pages

reference_components.identity_limitation: Single vs4-in-1 variant must match author hardware before selecting geometry

scope: Checked-source availability ledger, not proof that a CAD file exists nowhere; no component substitutions or purchases made
